title: Turn off package feeds
summary: The confirmation behind 'Turn off package feeds' on DJDL's Packages page: everything that stops across DJDL's 3 feeds (installs, CI publishes, service tokens), what is kept, and a typed confirmation.
compare: Opens from the foot row on Packages, which stays dimmed behind it; a danger dialog with the warning icon.

The title is a question naming the product ('Turn off package feeds for DJDL?'); the body lists what stops in bold lead-ins: Installs (3 packages, 3,132 installs in the last 30 days, the error people see), CI publishes (the three package names), Service tokens (Plugin CI and Docs build).
A quiet line says nothing is deleted (versions, tokens and access stay) and that copies on PyPI.org stay there.
Typed confirmation with the product slug 'djdl' in the kit's danger confirm word; the button says exactly what happens: 'Turn off package feeds'. Cancel is the kit's outline button.
Phone: the kit's bottom sheet with the buttons pinned full width, the danger button on top.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink; focus, hover, checked and selected take the accent of the service the element references (B17), never a status colour; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.
Ship builds is one identity (B5): Release cyan rule, chip, tile and nav marker, the Package glyph, crumb '<Product> › Ship builds'; no per-page green or tangerine.

Dialog and drawer head (B4): a 3px rule in the origin's accent along the top (none on a destructive or cautious confirmation), a head band with a hairline, one leading glyph or none (severity on a confirmation, the subject's mark on a record, never a service tile), title at or under 20/28; blurred backdrop with a flat fallback under reduced transparency.
B17: Service tokens and the CI token rows are core; feeds, packages and installs are release.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Narrated bullets; the destructive reassurance is last at 12px muted.
findings.resolution: Lead-in removed; bullets 'Installs: 3 packages, 3,132 installs in 30 days', 'CI publishes: release.yml can't publish', 'Service tokens: Plugin CI and Docs build can't install'; 'Nothing is deleted. Copies on PyPI.org stay.' is the first line at 14px. The page behind is the updated Packages page.
